sentences.en: This saying reminds us that some things will happen naturally even without external incentives, just as we grow in adversity.

phrase.zh: 世事不必爭人我 身心放下見乾坤
phrase.en: Needless to fight over self and others; Upon letting go, the Truth is revealed.

sentences.zh: 在生活中，我們常常因為競爭而迷失，世事不必爭人我，只有當我們學會放下身心，才能真正看到世界的本質。
sentences.en: In life, we often become lost due to competition; needless to fight over self and others, only by learning to let go of body and mind can we truly see the essence of the world.

phrase.zh: 世事有分別 人我一家親
phrase.en: Despite the differences in this world; Every person is family to me.

sentences.zh: 雖然世事有分別，但我始終相信人我一家親，無論在信仰、文化或背景上有多少不同，我們都應該彼此尊重和包容。
sentences.en: Even though there are differences in this world, I firmly believe that every person is family to me; regardless of our beliefs, cultures, or backgrounds, we should respect and embrace one another.

sentences.zh: 在這個世俗的社會中，我們常常面對各種信仰與價值觀的碰撞。
sentences.en: In this secular society, we often encounter clashes of various beliefs and values.

phrase.zh: 世有人我相 禪無分別心
phrase.en: In this world, there may be self and others; In Chan, the discriminative mind never was.

sentences.zh: 在這個世俗的世界裡，人們往往會感受到自我與他人的分別，但在禪修中，我們學會了超越這種對立，達到沒有分別心的境界。
sentences.en: In this secular world, people often feel the distinction between self and others, but in Chan practice, we learn to transcend this duality and reach a state of no discriminative mind.

sentences.zh: 每年，來自世界各地的佛光童軍成員都會參加世界佛光童軍大會，分享他們的經驗並建立友誼。
sentences.en: Every year, BLIA Scout members from around the world gather at the World BLIA Scout Jamboree to share their experiences and build friendships.

phrase.en: International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference

sentences.zh: 在今年的世界佛光青年大會上，來自世界各地的年輕人聚集在一起，分享他們對佛法的見解和生活的體驗。
sentences.en: At this year's International Buddha’s Light Young Adult Conference, young people from around the world gathered to share their insights on Buddhism and their experiences in life.

phrase.en: International Congress of World Buddhist Sangha Council

sentences.zh: 世界佛教僧伽會的成立旨在促進各國僧侶之間的交流與合作，共同維護佛教的精神與價值。
sentences.en: The establishment of the International Congress of World Buddhist Sangha Council aims to promote communication and collaboration among monks from different countries, jointly upholding the spirit and values of Buddhism.

phrase.en: The World Buddhist Lay Association Magazine

sentences.zh: 《世界佛教居士林林刊》是一份重要的刊物，透過文章和報導分享全球佛教信徒的心聲與智慧。
sentences.en: The World Buddhist Lay Association Magazine is an important publication that shares the voices and wisdom of Buddhist practitioners around the globe through articles and reports.

sentences.zh: 世界佛教徒聯誼會致力於促進全球佛教徒之間的交流與合作，弘揚佛教的核心價值觀。
sentences.en: The World Fellowship of Buddhists is dedicated to promoting communication and cooperation among Buddhists worldwide, upholding the core values of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 世界佛教比丘尼協會致力於促進女性在佛教中的地位，並為比丘尼提供支持和指導。
sentences.en: The World Buddhism Bhikkuni Association is dedicated to promoting the status of women in Buddhism and providing support and guidance for bhikkunis.

phrase.zh: 世界佛教美術圖說大辭典

sentences.zh: 《世界佛教美術圖說大辭典》是一本詳細介紹佛教藝術歷史與風格的重要參考書籍，涵蓋了各個時期與地區的佛教藝術作品。
sentences.en: The 'Encyclopedia of World Buddhist Arts' is an essential reference book that provides a detailed introduction to the history and styles of Buddhist art, covering works from various periods and regions.

phrase.zh: 世界佛教青年友誼大會
phrase.en: General Conference of the World Fellowship of Buddhist Youth

sentences.zh: 世界佛教青年友誼大會是全球佛教青年凝聚力量、分享理念和文化的重要平台，吸引了來自各國的參與者。
sentences.en: The General Conference of the World Fellowship of Buddhist Youth is an important platform for Buddhist youth around the world to unite, share ideas, and culture, attracting participants from various countries.

phrase.zh: 世界佛教青年會1985年學術會議

sentences.zh: 世界佛教青年會1985年學術會議吸引了來自各國的佛教青年，大家共同探討了佛教在當代社會中的角色與影響。
sentences.en: The 1985 WFBY Academic Conference attracted Buddhist youth from various countries, where they collectively discussed the role and impact of Buddhism in contemporary society.

phrase.zh: 世界佛教青年會學術會議

sentences.zh: 世界佛教青年會學術會議匯聚了來自各地的青年佛教徒，共同探討如何在當代社會中推廣佛教的價值觀。
sentences.en: The World Fellowship of Buddhist Youth (WFBY) academic conference brought together young Buddhists from around the world to collectively explore how to promote Buddhist values in contemporary society.

sentences.zh: 今年的世界僧伽會議聚集了來自各個國家的和尚，分享佛教的教義和實踐經驗。
sentences.en: This year's World Buddhist Sangha Conference gathered monks from various countries to share Buddhist teachings and practical experiences.

sentences.zh: 在世界僧伽會議上，與會者們深入探討了當前社會面臨的挑戰，以及佛教如何提供解決方法。
sentences.en: At the World Buddhist Sangha Conference, participants delved into the challenges faced by contemporary society and how Buddhism can offer solutions.

phrase.zh: 世界和平 世界一家
phrase.en: Peace for the World; One World, One Family

sentences.zh: 我們應該共同努力實現世界和平，因為在這個地球上，我們都是一家人。
sentences.en: We should work together to achieve peace for the world, as we are all one family on this planet.

sentences.zh: 推動世界和平的理念讓我們意識到，無論文化或信仰的差異，我們都生活在同一個世界裡。
sentences.en: The concept of promoting peace for the world reminds us that, despite our cultural or religious differences, we all live in the same world.

phrase.zh: 世界和平 天下一家
phrase.en: Peace for the World; One World, One Family

sentences.zh: 在這個多元文化的時代，我們應該共同努力促進世界和平，實現'天下一家'的理想。
sentences.en: In this era of diverse cultures, we should work together to promote peace for the world, realizing the ideal of 'One World, One Family'.

phrase.en: Pilgrimage And Religious Service for World Peace

sentences.zh: 每年，世界和平朝聖法會吸引來自各地的信徒，共同祈願世界的和平與繁榮。
sentences.en: Every year, the Pilgrimage And Religious Service for World Peace attracts believers from all over the world, who come together to pray for peace and prosperity in the world.

sentences.zh: 世界宗教交流促進了不同信仰之間的理解與尊重，讓各宗教的信徒能夠更加開放地分享彼此的文化與價值觀。
sentences.en: International religious exchange fosters understanding and respect between different faiths, allowing adherents of various religions to more openly share their cultures and values.

phrase.en: World Assembly of Religions for Peace

sentences.zh: 世界宗教和平會議的目的是促進不同信仰之間的對話與理解，以實現全球和平。
sentences.en: The World Assembly of Religions for Peace aims to promote dialogue and understanding among different faiths in order to achieve global peace.

phrase.en: World Council of Religions for Peace

sentences.zh: 世界宗教和平聯盟致力於促進不同宗教之間的對話與合作，為全球和平貢獻力量。
sentences.en: The World Council of Religions for Peace is dedicated to fostering dialogue and cooperation among different religions, contributing to global peace.

sentences.zh: 在這個世界宗教領導人大會上，來自不同信仰的領導人聚集在一起，共同探討促進和平與理解的方案。
sentences.en: At the World Religious Leaders' Conference, leaders from various faiths gathered together to discuss ways to promote peace and understanding.

sentences.zh: 每年的六月五日是世界環境日，這一天提醒我們關注環境保護與可持續發展的重要性。
sentences.en: Every year on June 5th, we celebrate World Environment Day, a day that reminds us of the importance of environmental protection and sustainable development.

phrase.en: When Buddha Meets the Gods Event

sentences.zh: 在這個世界神明聯誼會上，各路神明齊聚一堂，共同探討佛教智慧與天界的奧秘。
sentences.en: At the When Buddha Meets the Gods Event, deities from all realms gathered to explore the mysteries of Buddhist wisdom and the celestial world.

phrase.en: World Sutric And Tantric Buddhist Conference

sentences.zh: 去年，世界顯密佛教會議匯聚了來自不同國家的佛教徒，共同探討顯宗與密宗的精深教義。
sentences.en: Last year, the World Sutric And Tantric Buddhist Conference gathered Buddhists from various countries to explore the profound teachings of both the Sutric and Tantric traditions.

phrase.en: Spring Joy in the New Millennium

sentences.zh: 隨著新的世紀來臨，許多人感受到世紀生春的喜悅，期待著更美好的未來。
sentences.en: As the new millennium arrives, many people feel the spring joy in the new millennium, looking forward to a brighter future.

sentences.zh: 在這個世間中，我們常常面對無數的挑戰與困難，但這些經歷也讓我們成長。
sentences.en: In this world, we often face countless challenges and difficulties, but these experiences also help us grow.

phrase.zh: 世間有佛慈悲廣 胸中無私天地寬
phrase.en: In a world with a buddha present compassion develops; In a selfless heart the Universe widens.

sentences.zh: 當我們在世間認識到佛的慈悲廣大時，心中自然會生出無私的愛，而這樣的心態讓我們的生命變得更加寬廣。
sentences.en: When we recognize the vast compassion of the Buddha present in the world, a selfless love naturally arises within our hearts, allowing our lives to become much broader.

sentences.zh: 若能在生活中實踐佛陀的教導，則會感受到慈悲的力量，讓心靈無私，天地也隨之變得更加開闊。
sentences.en: If we can practice the teachings of the Buddha in our lives, we will experience the power of compassion, leading to a selfless spirit and an expansive universe.

phrase.zh: 世間有水皆歸海 天下無山空飛雲
phrase.en: All waters in this world return to the sea; No clouds float above empty mountains.

sentences.zh: 這句話提醒我們，無論世事如何變遷，所有的水最終都會匯聚進入大海，正如人們的生命經歷最終都會回歸於自然的懷抱。
sentences.en: This phrase reminds us that no matter how the affairs of the world change, all waters will eventually flow back to the sea, just as the experiences of life ultimately return to the embrace of nature.

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的山谷中，我凝視著空蕩蕩的山峰，心中思索著世間有水皆歸海的智慧，感受到一種深層的平靜。
sentences.en: In the tranquil valley, I gazed at the empty peaks, contemplating the wisdom that all waters return to the sea, feeling a profound sense of peace within.

sentences.zh: 世間法常常受到人心的影響，因此在追求物質享受的過程中，我們應該要保持心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: Worldly rules are often influenced by human emotions, so in the pursuit of material enjoyment, we should maintain the purity of our minds.

sentences.zh: 世間自然的法則是不可逆轉的，春花秋月如詩般的美景提醒著我們，生命中有許多值得珍惜的時刻。
sentences.en: The law of nature is irreversible; the splendor of spring flowers and autumn moon serves as a reminder that there are many moments in life worth cherishing.

sentences.zh: 作為一位世間解的智者，他深刻地理解人類的煩惱與喜悅，並用他的智慧指引他人走向解脫。
sentences.en: As a knower of the world, he profoundly understands the sorrows and joys of humanity, using his wisdom to guide others toward liberation.

phrase.en: Southeast Asia Charity And Dharma Propagation Tour

sentences.zh: 這次的中南半島慈善之旅，旨在為當地貧困社區提供幫助並推廣佛法。
sentences.en: The Southeast Asia Charity and Dharma Propagation Tour aims to provide assistance to impoverished communities and promote the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 中台禪寺以其雄偉的建築和寧靜的氛圍而聞名，吸引了許多尋求心靈平靜的遊客。
sentences.en: Chung Tai Chan Temple is renowned for its majestic architecture and serene ambiance, attracting many visitors seeking spiritual tranquility.

sentences.zh: 中國佛學會致力於推廣佛教文化與教育，並在全國範圍內舉辦各種活動來弘揚佛法。
sentences.en: The Chinese Buddhist Society is dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and education, organizing various activities nationwide to propagate the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 中國佛教的發展歷史悠久，它在文化和哲學上對中國社會產生了深遠的影響。
sentences.en: Chinese Buddhism has a long history of development, and it has had a profound impact on Chinese society in terms of culture and philosophy.

sentences.zh: 中國佛教史展現了佛教如何在不同時期和文化背景中發展，並影響了中國的哲學、藝術和社會結構。
sentences.en: The history of Chinese Buddhism showcases how Buddhism developed across different periods and cultural contexts, influencing China's philosophy, art, and social structure.

sentences.zh: 中國佛教哲學要義探討了如何在日常生活中實踐慈悲與智慧的理念，對於修行者的成長至關重要。
sentences.en: The essence of Chinese Buddhist philosophy explores how to practice compassion and wisdom in daily life, which is crucial for the growth of practitioners.

sentences.zh: 這本《中國佛教文化論叢》匯集了多位學者對中國佛教歷史與文化的深入研究與見解。
sentences.en: This collection of 'Chinese Buddhist Cultural Essays' gathers in-depth studies and insights from various scholars on the history and culture of Chinese Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 中國佛教會台灣省會員代表大會
phrase.en: General Meeting of the Member's Representatives of Buddhist Association, R.O.C.

sentences.zh: 在中國佛教會台灣省會員代表大會上，來自各地的會友們聚集一堂，共同討論佛教發展的未來方向。
sentences.en: At the General Meeting of the Member's Representatives of Buddhist Association, R.O.C., members from various regions gathered together to discuss the future direction of Buddhist development.

sentences.zh: 《中國佛教百科叢書》是一部翔實而全面的資料庫，詳盡介紹了中國佛教的歷史、思想和各種流派。
sentences.en: The 'Encyclopedia of Chinese Buddhism' is a comprehensive and detailed database that provides an in-depth introduction to the history, philosophy, and various sects of Chinese Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 《中國佛教通史》一書全面梳理了佛教在中國的傳入、發展及其對中國文化的深遠影響。
sentences.en: The book 'History of Chinese Buddhism' comprehensively outlines the introduction and development of Buddhism in China and its profound impact on Chinese culture.

phrase.en: A Collection of Biographies of Eminent Monks in Chinese Buddhism

sentences.zh: 《中國佛教高僧全集》是一部重要的文獻，記錄了中國歷史上許多卓越和尚的生平與業績，對研究中國佛教的發展具有深遠的意義。
sentences.en: A Collection of Biographies of Eminent Monks in Chinese Buddhism is an important document that records the lives and achievements of many outstanding monks in Chinese history, holding profound significance for the study of the development of Chinese Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這部中國佛教高僧漫畫生動地描繪了高僧們在歷史中的冒險與勇氣，讓年輕一代更能理解佛教的智慧和教義。
sentences.en: This comic about the Buddhist legends of high monks vividly depicts their adventures and courage throughout history, helping the younger generation better understand the wisdom and teachings of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 中國宜興國際素食文化暨綠色生活名品博覽會
phrase.en: International Vegetarian And Green Products Expo At Yixing, Mainland China

sentences.zh: 在中國宜興國際素食文化暨綠色生活名品博覽會上，來自世界各地的參展商分享了他們在素食和環保產品方面的創新成果。
sentences.en: At the International Vegetarian And Green Products Expo at Yixing, Mainland China, exhibitors from around the world showcased their innovative achievements in vegetarian and eco-friendly products.

sentences.zh: 這本書是中國禪修入門的指南，透過深刻的洞察力，教導我們如何在生活的各個層面中找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: This book serves as an introduction to Chinese Zen practice, teaching us how to find inner peace in all aspects of life through profound insights.

sentences.zh: 法門寺位於中國西安，是一座著名的佛教寺廟，以其悠久的歷史和珍貴的佛教 relics 而聞名。
sentences.en: Famen Temple, located near Xi'an, China, is a renowned Buddhist temple famous for its long history and precious Buddhist relics.

sentences.zh: 中壢圓光寺是當地信徒朝聖的重要地點，吸引了許多尋求心靈平靜的參訪者。
sentences.en: Yuan Guang Buddhist Temple in Zhongli is an important pilgrimage site for local devotees, attracting many visitors seeking spiritual tranquility.

sentences.zh: 中央日報作為一家知名的報紙，經常報導與佛教有關的重要新聞和事件。
sentences.en: Central Daily News, as a prominent newspaper, often reports significant news and events related to Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 中巴佛光康寧醫院致力於提供高品質的醫療服務，並且秉持著慈悲與服務的精神，讓每位病人都能感受到關懷和溫暖。
sentences.en: Hospital Los Angeles Paraguay-China is committed to providing high-quality medical services, upholding the spirit of compassion and service, so that every patient can feel cared for and welcomed.

sentences.zh: 每當月末，我們都會在中流舉行一個分享會，討論當月的學習進展和未來的計劃。
sentences.en: At the end of each month, we hold a sharing session at Middle Stream Monthly to discuss our learning progress and future plans.

phrase.en: A Dictionary of Chinese Buddhist Terms

sentences.zh: 這本中英佛學辭典對於研究佛教文化和哲學的學者來說，是一個不可或缺的參考工具。
sentences.en: This A Dictionary of Chinese Buddhist Terms is an indispensable reference tool for scholars studying Buddhist culture and philosophy.

sentences.zh: 這套中英對照佛學叢書提供了現代讀者深入理解佛教教義的機會，讓他們在學習的同時也能體會到中西文化的交流。
sentences.en: This series of contemporary bilingual Buddhist books offers modern readers the opportunity to gain a deep understanding of Buddhist teachings while experiencing the exchange of Eastern and Western cultures.

phrase.en: Bilingual Buddhist Series: Sutras & Scriptures Doctrines of Buddhism

sentences.zh: 這套中英對照佛學叢書將古老的經典與現代的解釋結合在一起，讓讀者能夠更深入地了解佛教的智慧與教義。
sentences.en: This bilingual Buddhist series combines ancient texts with modern interpretations, enabling readers to gain a deeper understanding of the wisdom and doctrines of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 中英對照佛學叢書：教理之部
phrase.en: Bilingual Buddhist Series: Doctrines of Buddhism

sentences.zh: 這本《中英對照佛學叢書：教理之部》深入探討佛教的基本教義，對初學者和研究者都非常有幫助。
sentences.en: This 'Bilingual Buddhist Series: Doctrines of Buddhism' delves deeply into the fundamental doctrines of Buddhism, making it highly beneficial for both beginners and researchers.

phrase.zh: 中英對照佛學叢書：經典之部

sentences.zh: 這本中英對照佛學叢書：經典之部，為讀者提供了翻譯精準的佛教經典，使他們能夠更深入地了解佛教的教義。
sentences.en: This bilingual Buddhist series: Sutras & Scriptures provides readers with accurately translated Buddhist classics, allowing them to gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist teachings.

phrase.zh: 中華佛光青年團員大會

sentences.zh: 今年的中華佛光青年團員大會將匯聚來自全國各地的青年，共同探討佛教在當代社會的角色與影響。
sentences.en: This year's BLIA-YAD Chunghwa General Conference will bring together youth from all over the country to discuss the role and impact of Buddhism in contemporary society.

sentences.zh: 中華佛學研究所致力於推廣和研究佛教文化，吸引了許多學者和修行者的參與。
sentences.en: The Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Studies is dedicated to promoting and researching Buddhist culture, attracting many scholars and practitioners.

sentences.zh: 中華佛寺協會致力於促進佛教文化的傳承與發展，並提供信徒一個學習與修行的場所。
sentences.en: The Chinese Buddhist Temple Association is dedicated to promoting the preservation and development of Buddhist culture, providing a space for practitioners to learn and cultivate their spiritual practice.

phrase.en: Lay Buddhists' Association, Republic of China

sentences.zh: 中華佛教居士會致力於推廣佛教的教義，並為信徒提供一個互相交流和學習的平台。
sentences.en: The Lay Buddhists' Association, Republic of China is dedicated to promoting the teachings of Buddhism and providing a platform for practitioners to exchange and learn from each other.

sentences.zh: 中華佛教文化館致力於弘揚佛教文化，舉辦各種活動以促進對佛教的理解與實踐。
sentences.en: The Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Culture is dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and hosts various activities to enhance understanding and practice of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 中華佛教文化館影印大藏經宣傳活動
phrase.en: Promotion of Tripitaka Reprinting Organized By Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Culture

sentences.zh: 中華佛教文化館影印大藏經宣傳活動旨在向大眾介紹大藏經的精神與智慧，並鼓勵更多的人參與佛教文獻的學習與傳承。
sentences.en: The promotion of Tripitaka reprinting organized by the Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Culture aims to introduce the spirit and wisdom of the Tripitaka to the public and encourage more people to engage in the study and preservation of Buddhist texts.

sentences.zh: 中華佛教總會成立於1910年代，旨在促進佛教的發展與交流，並加強海內外佛教徒之間的聯繫。
sentences.en: The Chinese Buddhist General Association was established in the 1910s with the aim of promoting the development and exchange of Buddhism, as well as strengthening the connections among Buddhist practitioners both domestically and abroad.

phrase.en: Buddhist Goodwill Visiting Party of R.O.C.

sentences.zh: 中華佛教親善訪問團透過與各國佛教團體交流，促進了不同文化間的理解與和諧。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Goodwill Visiting Party of R.O.C. promoted understanding and harmony between different cultures through exchanges with Buddhist organizations from various countries.

sentences.zh: 中華佛教青年會致力於推廣佛教文化，同時鼓勵年輕人參與佛教活動，促進心靈成長。
sentences.en: The Chinese Young Buddhist Association is committed to promoting Buddhist culture while encouraging young people to participate in Buddhist activities that foster spiritual growth.

sentences.zh: 中觀是由龍樹大師所創立的哲學派別，強調中道的觀點，反對任何極端的見解。
sentences.en: Madhyamaka is the philosophical school founded by Nagarjuna, emphasizing the view of the Middle Way and opposing any extreme perspectives.

sentences.zh: 中觀寺以其壯觀的建築和幽靜的氛圍而聞名，每年吸引著成千上萬的信徒和遊客前來參拜。
sentences.en: Zhong Guang Temple is renowned for its magnificent architecture and serene atmosphere, attracting thousands of devotees and tourists each year to pay their respects.

sentences.zh: 佛教的教義強調中道，這是一種避免極端的生活方式，尋求平衡和和諧。
sentences.en: The teachings of Buddhism emphasize the Middle Way, which is a lifestyle that avoids extremes, seeking balance and harmony.

sentences.zh: 在這部經典的佛教故事中，主人翁的智慧和慈悲啟發了許多人，讓他們領悟到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In this classic Buddhist tale, the master's wisdom and compassion inspired many, leading them to realize the inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這位主任以其出色的領導才能和遠見為團隊帶來了巨大的改變。
sentences.en: The director has brought significant changes to the team with his exceptional leadership skills and visionary outlook.

sentences.zh: 在這個會議上，主任委員發表了重要的演講，強調了未來的發展方向。
sentences.en: At this meeting, the executive director delivered an important speech emphasizing the future direction of development.

sentences.zh: 作為慈濟的主任委員，他負責協調各個項目並確保一切運作順利。
sentences.en: As the committee director of Tzu Chi, he is responsible for coordinating various projects and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

sentences.zh: 會議的主席負責組織和引導討論，確保每個參與者都有發言的機會。
sentences.en: The chairperson of the meeting is responsible for organizing and guiding the discussion, ensuring that every participant has an opportunity to speak.

sentences.zh: 每當節日來臨，信徒們都會聚集在寺廟的主殿，誠心誦經以求得祝福。
sentences.en: Whenever the festival comes, devotees gather in the main shrine of the temple, sincerely chanting scriptures to seek blessings.

sentences.zh: 在這個重要的法會上，主法的僧人以其深厚的智慧和慈悲引導了眾多信徒。
sentences.en: At this important ceremony, the presiding master guided many practitioners with profound wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在這個項目中，主管負責指導團隊成員，確保每個人都朝著共同的目標努力。
sentences.en: In this project, the supervisor is responsible for guiding the team members, ensuring that everyone works towards a common goal.

sentences.zh: 作為這本雜誌的主編，他負責確保所有文章的質量和內容的準確性。
sentences.en: As the editor-in-chief of the magazine, he is responsible for ensuring the quality of all articles and the accuracy of the content.

sentences.zh: 藝術的美感往往是主觀的，每個人對於作品的理解和感受都可能有所不同。
sentences.en: The aesthetic of art is often subjective; each person may have different interpretations and feelings towards a work.

phrase.zh: 主題演說：當代人心思潮
phrase.en: Keynote Speeches: Wise Thoughts, Modern Mentality

sentences.zh: 在這次的主題演說中，專家們分享了對當代人心思潮的深刻見解，探討了智慧與現代心態之間的關係。
sentences.en: In this keynote speech, experts shared profound insights into the modern mentality of contemporary individuals, exploring the relationship between wisdom and modern thoughts.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的主館中，信徒們聚集在一起，共同進行誦經和冥想。
sentences.en: In the main hall of the temple, devotees gather together to chant sutras and meditate.

phrase.zh: 九二一震災聯合公祭驅驚生亡兩利大法會

sentences.zh: 在九二一震災聯合公祭驅驚生亡兩利大法會上，參加者們共同祈願，願亡靈得以安息，生者能夠獲得內心的平靜與重生的力量。
sentences.en: During the Taiwan September 21st Earthquake Dharma Service, participants gathered to collectively pray for the peace of the departed souls and for the living to gain inner tranquility and the strength for rebirth.

sentences.zh: 修習九住心能幫助我們逐步深化對內心狀態的理解，讓我們在日常生活中更加專注和平靜。
sentences.en: Practicing the nine stages of mindfulness helps us gradually deepen our understanding of our inner states, allowing us to be more focused and peaceful in our daily lives.

phrase.en: Nine Grades of Rebirth in the Pure Land

sentences.zh: 根據佛教的教義，九品往生的概念讓信徒明白，即使是在不同的層次上，他們依然有機會在往生後進入極樂世界。
sentences.en: According to Buddhist teachings, the concept of the Nine Grades of Rebirth allows practitioners to understand that even at different levels, they still have the chance to enter the Pure Land after rebirth.

sentences.zh: 在九品往生中，上品上生象徵著最優秀的修行者，表現出至高無上的品德和智慧。
sentences.en: In the Nine Grades of Rebirth, the top of the highest grade symbolizes the most outstanding practitioners, demonstrating supreme virtue and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 信徒可以透過修行來提升自己的品位，例如透過精進的念佛，從而希望達到上品中生或更高的境界。
sentences.en: Practitioners can elevate their status through diligent practice, such as earnest recitation of Buddha's name, aspiring to reach the middle of the highest grade or even higher realms.

sentences.zh: 中品往生的目標讓我們明白，成為一位中等優秀的修行者仍然能夠獲得往生的機會，值得每一位信徒努力追求。
sentences.en: The goal of the intermediary grade of rebirth reminds us that being an average practitioner still offers the chance for rebirth, which is a worthy pursuit for every believer.

sentences.zh: 下品往生雖然屬於最低等級，但依然提供了信眾往生的希望，鼓勵大家繼續精進修行。
sentences.en: While the lowest grades of rebirth may be considered inferior, they still provide hope for practitioners, encouraging everyone to continue striving for improvement in their practice.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信，透過修行及累積善行，可以達到九品蓮的境界，最終成為如蓮花般聖潔及圓滿的人。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that through practice and accumulating good deeds, one can reach the Nine Stages of Lotus Incarnation, ultimately becoming a person as pure and complete as a lotus flower.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，九品蓮台象徵著不同層次的念佛修行，最終能夠讓信眾在往生後獲得蓮花寶座的圓滿。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Nine Stages of Lotus Thrones symbolize the various levels of recitation practice, ultimately allowing practitioners to attain a lotus throne of perfection after rebirth.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，九品蓮開代表著修行者在菩提心修持過程中所經歷的九個不同階段，象徵著智慧與慈悲的逐漸成熟。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Nine Stages of Lotus Blossoms represents the nine different stages a practitioner goes through in cultivating the Bodhi heart, symbolizing the gradual maturation of wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，乞士以乞食的方式來表達對生活的簡單需求，並提醒人們珍惜所擁有的。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, begging serves as a way for beggars to express their simple needs for sustenance, reminding people to cherish what they have.

sentences.zh: 在城市的街道上，他經常看到許多人乞食，希望能獲得一頓簡單的飯。
sentences.en: On the streets of the city, he often saw many people begging for food, hoping to get a simple meal.

sentences.zh: 某些修道士選擇乞食作為他們生活的一部分，以表達對物質世界的放下。
sentences.en: Some monks choose begging for food as a part of their life to express their detachment from the material world.

phrase.zh: 乾坤容我靜 名利任人忙
phrase.en: The universe is my place of calm; Fame and gain are what keep me busy.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的都市生活中，我總是提醒自己，乾坤容我靜，名利任人忙，這樣才能找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In the hustle and bustle of city life, I always remind myself that the universe is my place of calm; fame and gain are what keep others busy, so I can find peace within.

phrase.zh: 了不起與沒有什麼了不起

sentences.zh: 在生活中，我們常常會遇到許多了不起的人與事，但有時候，簡單的小事也能讓人感受到沒有什麼了不起的道理。
sentences.en: In life, we often encounter many amazing people and things, but sometimes, simple little things can also convey the understanding that not everything is so amazing.

phrase.en: Perfectly Clear: A Mind Awakened to the Way

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，他漸漸地了了分明覺道於心，感受到內心的平靜和歡喜。
sentences.en: During his practice, he gradually became perfectly clear, awakening his mind to the Way and feeling a profound sense of peace and joy within.

phrase.zh: 了卻人間多少事 笑開天下古今愁
phrase.en: See through the many mundane affairs, Laugh away sorrows past and present.

sentences.zh: 在喧囂的城市中，他學會了了卻人間多少事，並以笑容來化解古今愁苦。
sentences.en: In the bustling city, he learned to see through the many mundane affairs and use his smile to dissolve sorrows past and present.

phrase.en: Attain a Perfect Understanding of the Origin of Your Mind

sentences.zh: 在靜坐冥想中，他逐漸了悟心源，明白了自我意識的本質與根本來源。
sentences.en: During his meditation, he gradually attained a perfect understanding of the origin of his mind, realizing the nature and fundamental source of self-awareness.

phrase.en: Attain a Perfect Understanding in the Here and Now

sentences.zh: 修行者通過靜坐與觀察，最終了悟當下，體會到生活中的每一刻都是千載難逢的禮物。
sentences.en: Through meditation and observation, the practitioner ultimately attains a perfect understanding in the here and now, realizing that every moment in life is a unique gift.

phrase.en: Completely Free of Worries Without obstacles

sentences.zh: 在禪修的狀態中，她感受到了一種了無罣礙沒有牽絆的自由，心靈如同清澈的湖水般平靜。
sentences.en: In a state of meditation, she experienced a freedom that was completely free of worries without obstacles, her mind as calm as a clear lake.

phrase.en: ending the cycle of birth and death

sentences.zh: 通過修行，許多人追尋了生死的智慧，期望能夠超脫於輪迴之中，達到永恆的寧靜。
sentences.en: Through practice, many seek the wisdom of ending the cycle of birth and death, hoping to transcend the wheel of existence and attain eternal peace.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，事事無礙的概念強調萬物之間的相互關聯與和諧，使我們能夠理解和接受現實的本質。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the concept of mutual unobstructedness among phenomena emphasizes the interconnectedness and harmony among all things, allowing us to understand and accept the true nature of reality.

phrase.zh: 事有人我相 禪無分別心
phrase.en: Characteristics of self and other are found in phenomena; Discriminative minds are absent in Chan.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，當我們明白事有人我相，便能看清形而上的現象，而禪宗教導我們擺脫分別心，進入更深的內心安寧。
sentences.en: In practice, when we understand that the characteristics of self and other are found in phenomena, we can see through the metaphysical realm, while Zen teaches us to let go of discriminative minds and enter a deeper state of inner peace.

phrase.zh: 事能知足心常泰 人到無求品自高
phrase.en: A contented mind is a perpetual feast; A mind bereft of desire naturally makes one noble.

sentences.zh: 當我們能夠知足常樂時，心中便會擁有無限的平靜與喜悅，這就是真正的幸福。
sentences.en: When we can be content and find joy in what we have, our hearts will be filled with infinite peace and happiness, which is the true essence of joy.

sentences.zh: 人若能放下對物質和名利的渴求，便能心如明鏡，俯仰無愧，從而彰顯其崇高的品格。
sentences.en: If one can let go of desires for material possessions and fame, their mind will reflect clarity, and they will stand upright with no regrets, thereby revealing their noble character.

phrase.en: when things go against your will

sentences.zh: 生活中常常會出現事與願違的情況，讓人感到困惑和失落。
sentences.en: In life, there are often situations when things go against your will, leaving one feeling confused and disheartened.

sentences.zh: 他在二六時內完成了所有的冥想練習，感覺心靈的平靜與清晰。
sentences.en: He completed all his meditation practices within twelve hours, feeling a sense of calmness and clarity in his mind.

phrase.zh: 二十一世紀的未來世界

sentences.zh: 隨著科技的迅速發展，二十一世紀的未來世界充滿了無限的可能性與挑戰，讓人們對未來充滿期待。
sentences.en: With the rapid advancement of technology, the prospects of the 21st century are filled with infinite possibilities and challenges, leaving people eager for what the future holds.

sentences.zh: 研究二十四史是中國歷史學者的重要任務，因為這些史書記錄了中國古代各個朝代的興衰變遷。
sentences.en: Studying the Twenty-four Dynastic Histories is an important task for Chinese historians, as these historical texts document the rise and fall of various ancient dynasties in China.

sentences.zh: 在這個快速變化的世界中，我們可以通過反思來發現二十樂，比如錯誤之後的懺悔，讓我們的心靈獲得平靜。
sentences.en: In this rapidly changing world, we can discover the twenty ways to find joy, such as the peace of mind that comes from reflection and repentance after making mistakes.

sentences.zh: 安份的人樂在其中，專注於當下的生活，享受每一天的小確幸。
sentences.en: Those who are content find joy in enjoying their actions, focusing on the present and savoring the small pleasures of everyday life.

sentences.zh: 中獎的人樂不可支，因為他們的努力終於得到了回報，無法抑制心中的喜悅。
sentences.en: Prizewinners find joy in rewards, unable to contain their excitement as their hard work finally pays off.

sentences.zh: 喜捨的人樂善好施，總是樂於幫助那些需要幫助的人，這讓他們感到無比的快樂。
sentences.en: Generous people find joy in giving, always eager to help those in need, which brings them immense happiness.

sentences.zh: 熱心的人樂於公益，積極參與社會服務，為他人帶來了希望與支持。
sentences.en: Passionate people find joy in philanthropy, actively engaging in social services and bringing hope and support to others.

sentences.zh: 隨緣的人樂天知命，接受生命中的一切，並在每個瞬間中尋找喜悅。
sentences.en: Those who go with the flow find joy in being content with whatever comes their way, discovering happiness in every moment.

sentences.zh: 自在的人樂山愛水，在大自然的懷抱中找到了平靜與喜悅。
sentences.en: Carefree people find joy relaxing in nature, finding peace and happiness amidst the beauty of mountains and waters.

sentences.zh: 旅行的人樂不思蜀，沉浸於探索新地方的樂趣之中，忘卻了過去的煩憂。
sentences.en: Travelers find joy being away from home, immersed in the joy of discovering new places, forgetting their past worries.

sentences.zh: 精進的人樂而不荒，對於自己的修行充滿熱情，努力不懈，享受每一刻的進步。
sentences.en: Diligent people find joy in zealous practice, passionately and consistently working on their improvement and enjoying every moment of progress.

sentences.zh: 淡泊的人樂業安居，過著簡樸的生活，心中充滿了安寧與滿足。
sentences.en: Detached people find joy in a simple life, living modestly and filled with peace and satisfaction in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 逍遙的人樂以忘憂，活在當下，讓煩惱隨風而去，歡享生活的每一個瞬間。
sentences.en: Free people find joy in forgetting their troubles, living in the moment, letting worries blow away and relishing each second of life.

sentences.zh: 研究的人樂此不疲，對學術的探求與求知的渴望讓他們充滿了愉悅。
sentences.en: Researchers find joy in conducting their studies, filled with delight and desire for knowledge as they pursue academic inquiries.

sentences.zh: 知足的人樂貧安逸，珍惜生活中的每一點，享受著簡單與寧靜所帶來的快樂。
sentences.en: Content people find joy in living a simple life, cherishing every little thing and enjoying the happiness that simplicity and tranquility bring.

sentences.zh: 慈悲的人樂善好義，通過行善積德而獲得心靈的滿足與快樂。
sentences.en: Compassionate people find joy in kind and righteous deeds, achieving fulfillment and happiness through their good actions.

sentences.zh: 蜜月的人樂愛相待，享受彼此的陪伴，讓愛的感覺充盈他們的生活。
sentences.en: Honeymooners find joy in being with each other, savoring each other's company and letting the feeling of love fill their lives.

sentences.zh: 無我的人樂於分享，將自己的幸福擴展給他人，讓社會更為和諧。
sentences.en: Selfless people find joy in sharing, extending their happiness to others and creating a more harmonious society.

sentences.zh: 莊重的人樂而不邪，以正直的行為獲得內心的平靜與快樂。
sentences.en: Righteous people find joy in being upright, obtaining inner peace and happiness through their honorable actions.

sentences.zh: 豐收的人樂見成果，對於自己的努力得到的回報感到欣慰與喜悅。
sentences.en: Farmers find joy in a fruitful harvest, feeling gratified and joyful for the rewards of their hard work.

sentences.zh: 興奮的人樂而能定，能在激動之中找到平靜，保持心靈的平衡。
sentences.en: Excited people find joy in peace after moments of excitement, able to find calmness and maintain balance in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 修道的人樂道安貧，通過追求精神的悠閒和簡樸，獲得生命的真正意義。
sentences.en: Spiritual practitioners find joy in the Way and frugality, gaining the true meaning of life through a pursuit of spiritual ease and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 在這次會議上，二單書記強調了團隊合作的重要性，並提出了改進工作流程的建議。
sentences.en: At the meeting, the Second Deputy Secretary emphasized the importance of teamwork and presented suggestions for improving workflow.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的管理中，二單監寺負責協助主要監寺，確保一切運作順利。
sentences.en: In the management of the monastery, the Second Deputy Superintendent is responsible for assisting the main superintendent to ensure everything operates smoothly.

sentences.zh: 在傳統的佛教儀式中，二壇是承載重要法會的地方，象徵著深化修行的階段。
sentences.en: In traditional Buddhist rituals, the second platform serves as a significant space for important ceremonies, symbolizing a stage of deepening practice.

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟中，二眾塔象徵著僧眾與信徒的和諧共處，是朝聖者必訪的聖地。
sentences.en: In this temple, the Two Assemblies Pagoda symbolizes the harmonious coexistence of monks and devotees, making it a must-visit holy site for pilgrims.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，二禪是一個更深層次的境界，修行者達到內心的寧靜，感受到無所執著的喜悅。
sentences.en: In practice, the second dhyana represents a deeper state of meditative absorption, where practitioners attain inner peace and experience the joy of non-attachment.

phrase.en: They are different, yet the same

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，二而一的概念提醒我們，雖然眾生各有不同，但在本質上都是相互聯結的。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the concept of 'they are different, yet the same' reminds us that while all beings are unique, they are fundamentally interconnected.

sentences.zh: 經典中反復提到云何應住，提醒修行者們要在智慧和慈悲中安住，以達到內心的平靜與覺悟。
sentences.en: The scriptures repeatedly mention 'In what should one abide?' urging practitioners to dwell in wisdom and compassion in order to achieve inner peace and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 五乘佛法教導我們，透過不同的乘法，無論是人乘、天乘、聲聞乘、緣覺乘還是菩薩乘，都能達到最終的解脫與悟道。
sentences.en: The Five Vehicles teach us that through different paths, whether the Human vehicle, Heavenly vehicle, Sravaka vehicle, Pratyekabuddha vehicle, or Bodhisattva vehicle, we can all reach ultimate liberation and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 五停心觀是一種深奧的修行方法，透過不淨觀，我們可以意識到身體的無常與不潔。
sentences.en: The Five Contemplations is a profound practice, through the contemplation of impurity, we can realize the impermanence and impurity of the body.

sentences.zh: 進一步的慈悲觀能讓我們培養對所有眾生的同情心，並激發行善的動機。
sentences.en: Further, the contemplation of loving-kindness and compassion allows us to cultivate empathy for all beings and inspires our motivation to do good.

sentences.zh: 因緣觀幫助我們理解生活中事物之間的相互關聯，從而減少對於自我和他人的執著。
sentences.en: The contemplation of causes and conditions helps us understand the interconnectedness of things in life, reducing our attachment to self and others.

sentences.zh: 念佛觀則引導信徒專注於佛陀的智慧與慈悲，增強內心的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: The contemplation of the Buddha guides practitioners to focus on the wisdom and compassion of the Buddha, strengthening inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 最後，數息觀是一種有效的冥想方法，可以幫助我們安定心神，深化對呼吸的覺察。
sentences.en: Finally, the contemplation of counting the breath is an effective meditation technique that helps stabilize the mind and deepen awareness of breathing.

sentences.zh: 五台山真容院是佛教朝聖者的重要目的地，許多人前來此地進行靜修和祈禱。
sentences.en: Zhenrong Temple on Mount Wutai is an important destination for Buddhist pilgrims, where many come for meditation and prayer.

sentences.zh: 五和的理念強調了自心和樂，意味著每個人都應該追求內心的快樂與和諧。
sentences.en: The concept of Five Harmonies emphasizes individual harmony achieved through joy, meaning that everyone should strive for inner happiness and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，人我和敬讓我們學會尊重彼此，建立良好的人際關係。
sentences.en: In daily life, interpersonal harmony achieved through respect teaches us to value each other, fostering healthy relationships.

sentences.zh: 家庭和順是五和中的重要一環，家庭成員間的相互尊重和支持是維持家庭和諧的基石。
sentences.en: Family harmony, an important aspect of the Five Harmonies, relies on mutual respect and support among family members as the cornerstone of maintaining harmony.

sentences.zh: 通過合作，社會和諧得以實現，社區成員應該攜手合作，克服各種挑戰。
sentences.en: Through cooperation, social harmony is achieved, as community members should come together to overcome various challenges.

sentences.zh: 最終，世界和平是五和的最高理想，只有當每個人都努力追求和諧，才能實現真正的和平。
sentences.en: Ultimately, world harmony is the highest ideal of the Five Harmonies; true peace can only be achieved when everyone strives for harmony.

sentences.zh: 五和塔是中國古代建築的傑作，象徵著五種和諧的元素，吸引了無數遊客前來欣賞其壯麗的建築風格。
sentences.en: The Five Harmonies Pagoda is a masterpiece of ancient Chinese architecture, symbolizing the five elements of harmony, attracting countless visitors to admire its magnificent architectural style.

phrase.en: Chan Schools: 1. The Linji School; 2. The Guiyang School; 3. The Caodong School; 4. The Yunmen School; 5. The Fayan School; 6. The Yangqi School; 7. The Huanglong School

sentences.zh: 五家七派是中國禪宗的重要分類，其中包括臨濟宗、溈仰宗、曹洞宗、雲門宗、法眼宗、楊岐派和黃龍派，每一派都有其獨特的教義與修行方法。
sentences.en: The Chan Schools, categorized into five houses and seven branches, are an important classification in Chinese Zen Buddhism, which includes the Linji School, Guiyang School, Caodong School, Yunmen School, Fayan School, Yangqi School, and Huanglong School, each with its unique teachings and methods of practice.

sentences.zh: 五戒是佛教徒所遵循的重要道德準則，第一戒是「不殺」，這意味著要對所有生命心存慈悲，拒絕任何形式的暴力。
sentences.en: The Five Precepts are important moral guidelines followed by Buddhists, with the first precept being 'refrain from killing,' which means cultivating compassion towards all living beings and rejecting any form of violence.

sentences.zh: 第二戒是「不盜」，這教導我們尊重他人的財產，並且誠實地獲得應有的資源。
sentences.en: The second precept, 'refrain from stealing,' teaches us to respect others' property and to earn resources honestly.

sentences.zh: 第三戒「不邪淫」提醒我們在性愛關係中保持忠誠和誠信，避免對他人造成痛苦。
sentences.en: The third precept, 'refrain from sexual misconduct,' reminds us to maintain loyalty and honesty in sexual relationships to avoid causing suffering to others.

sentences.zh: 第四戒「不妄語」鼓勵我們說真話，避免欺騙他人，因為誠實是建立信任的基礎。
sentences.en: The fourth precept, 'refrain from lying,' encourages us to speak the truth and avoid deceiving others, as honesty is the foundation of building trust.

sentences.zh: 最後一戒「不飲酒」則警示我們要避免使人迷失的物質，以保持清醒的心智，培養良好的判斷力。
sentences.en: The final precept, 'refrain from consuming intoxicants,' warns us to avoid substances that lead to a loss of mindfulness, enabling us to maintain a clear mind and cultivate good judgment.

sentences.zh: 在五戒菩薩戒的受戒儀式中，信徒們發誓遵守五條基本戒律，以引導他們的生活更符合佛法。
sentences.en: During the ceremony of the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts, devotees pledge to uphold the five basic precepts to better align their lives with the teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟中，我參加了五戒菩薩戒戒會，深刻體會到持守戒律對修行的重要性。
sentences.en: In the temple, I attended the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony, deeply realizing the importance of upholding precepts in practice.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，五欲指的是財、色、名、食和睡，這些欲望如果過於追逐，會導致心靈的困擾。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the Five Desires refer to wealth, sex, fame, food and drink, and sleep; excessive pursuit of these desires can lead to mental turmoil.

sentences.zh: 修行者努力超越五欲，以追求更高的精神境界和內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Practitioners strive to transcend the Five Desires in pursuit of a higher spiritual realm and inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在這個五濁惡世中，我們面對著劫濁、見濁、煩惱濁、眾生濁和命濁的種種困境，唯有透過修行，才能逐漸超越種種束縛。
sentences.en: In this Saha World, we face various difficulties such as kalpa degeneration, view degeneration, affliction degeneration, sentient being degeneration, and life-span degeneration; only through practice can we gradually transcend these constraints.

sentences.zh: 五濁惡世的實相提醒著我們，隨著劫濁的存在，世間的變遷與苦難時刻影響著眾生的心靈。
sentences.en: The reality of the Saha World reminds us that with the existence of kalpa degeneration, the changes and sufferings in the world constantly affect the minds of sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，五無間罪被視為最嚴重的罪行，因為它們代表著一種不可中斷的苦痛，受苦無間使得罪人無法尋求解脫。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Five Uninterrupted Crimes are regarded as the gravest offenses, as they represent a state of uninterrupted suffering, rendering the sinner unable to seek liberation.

sentences.zh: 身形無間的概念在描述五無間罪時，強調了罪人在同一痛苦之中經歷著肉體形式的永恆存在。
sentences.en: The concept of Uninterrupted Physical Form emphasizes that, when describing the Five Uninterrupted Crimes, the sinner experiences an eternal existence within the same suffering physical condition.

sentences.zh: 在五無間罪的教義中，時間無間意味著受苦不會隨著時間的推移而減少，完全阻止了任何解脫的希望。
sentences.en: In the doctrine of the Five Uninterrupted Crimes, Uninterrupted Time means that the suffering does not diminish with the passage of time, completely thwarting any hope for liberation.

sentences.zh: 罪器無間的概念提醒我們，五無間罪的懲罰永無止境，刑具將不斷使用，使受刑者處於無窮的痛苦之中。
sentences.en: The notion of Uninterrupted Implements of Torture reminds us that the penalties for the Five Uninterrupted Crimes are endless, with instruments of torture constantly employed, placing the condemned in a state of perpetual agony.

sentences.zh: 最後，眾類無間的意義在於，所有受苦的眾生在五無間罪的懲罰中都是互相連結的，無法逃脫。
sentences.en: Lastly, the meaning of Uninterrupted Categories of Beings signifies that all suffering beings are interconnected in the punishment of the Five Uninterrupted Crimes, unable to escape their fate.

sentences.zh: 在靈山勝境的五百羅漢雕塑中，每一尊羅漢都展現了獨特的神情和故事，讓參觀者深刻體會到佛教的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: In the Five Hundred Arhat Garden at Lingshan, each sculpture of the Arhat displays a unique expression and story, allowing visitors to deeply experience the wisdom and compassion of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 在學習佛教文化的過程中，我們常常會遇到五種不翻的詞彙，這使得我們更深入地理解其複雜性和內涵。
sentences.en: In the process of studying Buddhist culture, we often encounter the five kinds of untranslatable terms, which deepens our understanding of their complexity and significance.

sentences.zh: 例如，多含不翻的詞彙可能在不同文境中有不同詮釋，而尊貴不翻的詞則直接反映了對某些人物或概念的崇敬。
sentences.en: For example, terms with multiple meanings may have different interpretations in various contexts, while terms of reverence directly reflect respect for certain figures or concepts.

sentences.zh: 此外，祕密不翻的詞彙往往涉及深奧的教義，順古不翻的詞則保留了傳統的音譯方式，這些都是翻譯者的挑戰。
sentences.en: Moreover, esoteric terms often involve profound doctrines, while traditionally transliterated terms retain their original phonetic forms, posing challenges for translators.

sentences.zh: 最後，此方無不翻的詞彙則是那些在其他語言中找不到對應的詞，這更顯示了佛教語言的獨特性。
sentences.en: Lastly, terms without a local equivalent are those that lack corresponding words in other languages, further highlighting the uniqueness of Buddhist terminology.

phrase.zh: 五聖同心開淨土 七眾協力護道場
phrase.en: With one mind, the Five Sages build Pure Lands; Through concerted effort, the Seven Assemblies support the cultivation court.

sentences.zh: 在這次的法會中，五聖同心開淨土，讓與會者感受到無比的祥和與安詳。
sentences.en: During this Dharma assembly, with one mind, the Five Sages built Pure Lands, allowing all participants to feel an unparalleled sense of peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 我們必須記住，只有七眾協力護道場，才能共同創造一個和諧的修行環境。
sentences.en: We must remember that only through concerted effort can the Seven Assemblies support the cultivation court and create a harmonious environment for practice.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，五蘊是構成個體存在的基本要素，包括色、受、想、行和識，而理解這五蘊的性質有助於解脫。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Five Aggregates are the fundamental elements that constitute individual existence, including form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness, and understanding the nature of these aggregates helps in attaining liberation.

sentences.zh: 色是物質的表現，受是感官的感受，想是對經驗的認知，行是心智的活動，而識則是意識的基礎。
sentences.en: Form is the manifestation of matter, feeling is the sensory experience, perception is the recognition of experiences, mental formations are the activities of the mind, and consciousness is the foundation of awareness.

phrase.zh: 五蘊皆空觀自在 六塵不染見如來
phrase.en: See that the Five Skandhas are empty: be at perfect ease; Remain untainted by the Six Objects: perceive the Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 在靜坐時，我深刻體會到五蘊皆空的真理，內心隨之變得自在無拘，無論外界的六塵如何變化，我心中卻始終清淨如如來般的真實。
sentences.en: During meditation, I deeply realized the truth that the Five Skandhas are empty, and my heart became free and unrestrained; regardless of the changes in the Six Objects of the world, my mind remained pure and true like that of the Tathagata.

phrase.zh: 五衰相現; 小五衰相
phrase.en: Five Signs of Decay: Five Minor Signs of Decay

sentences.zh: 五衰相現，是預示著個體的衰敗與失落的五個跡象，例如衣服垢穢，頭上的華萎，這些都提醒我們要常懷警覺之心。
sentences.en: The Five Signs of Decay are five indications of an individual's decline and loss, such as filthy clothes and a fading garland atop the head, reminding us to maintain a vigilant heart.

sentences.zh: 小五衰相更是微小卻深刻的變化，如樂聲不起和身光忽滅，這些都是對人生無常的深刻反思。
sentences.en: The Five Minor Signs of Decay are subtle yet profound changes, such as the music stopping and the body's radiance fading, serving as deep reflections on the impermanence of life.

sentences.zh: 在五觀堂內，僧侶們通過五種反思來深入理解生活的真理，這是修行的重要部分。
sentences.en: Within the Five Contemplations Hall, monks deepen their understanding of the truths of life through five kinds of reflections, which are an important part of their practice.

phrase.zh: 五觀若明金易化 三心未了水難消
phrase.en: If the Five Contemplations are fully practiced, even gold is easily consumed; Shall the Three Minds remain unaware, even water becomes indigestible.

sentences.zh: 如果五觀能夠明瞭，貴重的金子將變得容易被化解，正如智慧能夠超越物質的束縛。
sentences.en: If the Five Contemplations are clear, even precious gold will easily dissolve, just as wisdom transcends the constraints of material possessions.

sentences.zh: 然而，若三心仍然迷惘，甚至最基礎的水也會讓人難以消化，這是真理與無明之間的對比。
sentences.en: However, if the Three Minds remain confused, even the simplest water can become indigestible, illustrating the contrast between truth and ignorance.

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，五逆行為被視為極其嚴重的罪行，這包括殺父、殺母、殺阿羅漢、出佛身血和破和合僧，這些行為將使遭受重大的業報。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the Five Great Violations are regarded as extremely severe offenses, including killing one's father, killing one's mother, killing an arhat, shedding the blood of a buddha, and creating a schism in the monastic community, all of which lead to significant karmic repercussions.

sentences.zh: 修習佛法的信徒需特別警惕五逆的行為，以免在未來的輪迴中受苦。
sentences.en: Practitioners of Buddhism must be particularly vigilant about the Five Great Violations to avoid suffering in future rebirths.

phrase.en: throwing all five limbs to the ground

sentences.zh: 在禪修的過程中，他體會到了五體投地的意義，感受到對佛法的由衷敬仰與歸依。
sentences.en: During his meditation, he experienced the meaning of throwing all five limbs to the ground, feeling a deep admiration and surrender to the teachings of Buddhism.

phrase.en: To Enjoy and Appreciate Is Sufficient Enough

sentences.zh: 在生活的每一個瞬間，我們都應該記得，享有就好，珍惜眼前的美好時光。
sentences.en: In every moment of life, we should remember that to enjoy and appreciate is sufficient enough, cherishing the beautiful times in front of us.

sentences.zh: 他被尊稱為人中尊，因為他的智慧和慈悲使無數人受益。
sentences.en: He is honored as the Honored One among humans, as his wisdom and compassion have benefited countless people.

sentences.zh: 人事主任負責管理公司的各種人力資源政策，確保員工的需求和權益得到妥善照顧。
sentences.en: The Director of Human Resources is responsible for managing the company's various human resource policies, ensuring that employees' needs and rights are properly addressed.

phrase.zh: 人出巧言 以誠相接 人出漏言 以婉相答 人出戲言 以默相待 人出廢言 以簡相告
phrase.en: In hearing sweet words, Respond with honesty. In hearing flawed words, Respond with politeness. In hearing dishonest words, Respond with silence. In hearing idle words, Respond with brevity.

sentences.zh: 當他以巧言來稱讚你的時候，你應該以誠懇的態度來回應，這樣才能更好地建立彼此的信任。
sentences.en: When he praises you with sweet words, you should respond with sincerity to better establish mutual trust.

sentences.zh: 如果有人在討論中使用了不太準確的詞語，我們應該以婉轉的方式回答，以免傷害對方的感情。
sentences.en: If someone uses inaccurate words during a discussion, we should respond diplomatically to avoid hurting their feelings.

sentences.zh: 面對那些故意誤導的戲言，保持沉默是一種智慧的回應，讓自己不被渲染的情緒所影響。
sentences.en: In the face of intentionally misleading jokes, remaining silent is a wise response that protects you from being influenced by the emotional atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 當聽到某人真正無意義的閒談時，簡潔地表達自己的想法，可以更有效地引導對話。
sentences.en: When hearing someone engage in truly idle chatter, expressing your thoughts concisely can more effectively steer the conversation.

phrase.zh: 人勝諸天; 1. 勇猛勝 2. 憶念勝 3. 梵行勝
phrase.en: Human Realm: 1. superior bravery; 2. superior recollection; 3. superior pure practices

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，他體會到了人勝諸天的意義，尤其是勇猛勝，因為只有勇敢地面對內心的恐懼，才能獲得真正的解脫。
sentences.en: During his practice, he experienced the meaning of 'Human Realm' and particularly understood the value of superior bravery, for only by courageously facing the fears within can one attain true liberation.

sentences.zh: 她的憶念勝使她在冥想時能夠深入探索內心的智慧，從而明白了生命的真諦。
sentences.en: Her superior recollection allowed her to delve deeply into the wisdom of her heart during meditation, leading her to understand the true essence of life.

sentences.zh: 通過梵行勝的修行，他培養了無私的慈悲心，逐漸獲得了內心的平靜與自在。
sentences.en: Through the practice of superior pure practices, he cultivated a selfless compassion, gradually attaining inner peace and freedom.

phrase.zh: 人勤春來早 家和喜事多
phrase.en: Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families.

sentences.zh: 人勤春來早，這句話告訴我們，只要勤奮努力，便能迎接春天的到來，享受繁榮的生活。
sentences.en: The saying 'Happiness ensues diligent hearts' teaches us that through hard work and diligence, we can welcome the arrival of spring and enjoy a prosperous life.

sentences.zh: 家和喜事多，和睦的家庭關係能帶來無數的快樂和幸福，讓每一個成員都感受到愛與支持。
sentences.en: When 'Joy comes to harmonious families', it reflects how harmonious family relationships can bring immense happiness and joy, allowing each member to feel love and support.

phrase.en: we can only count on a single breath

sentences.zh: 在這瞬息萬變的世界裡，我們常常忘記了人命在呼吸間的重要性，珍惜每一口氣息才是活著的真諦。
sentences.en: In this rapidly changing world, we often forget the importance of the idea that we can only count on a single breath, and it is essential to cherish each breath as the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人和被視為建立和諧社會的重要基礎，因為每個人的互動與關係都影響著整體的和平與穩定。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, interpersonal harmony is regarded as a crucial foundation for building a harmonious society, as the interactions and relationships between individuals affect the overall peace and stability.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人和事成的智慧告訴我們，和諧的關係能夠促進所有事情的成功，無論是家庭、朋友還是工作夥伴之間。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the wisdom of 'harmony accomplishes everything' teaches us that harmonious relationships can foster success in all areas, whether among family, friends, or work partners.

sentences.zh: 在這個社區中，人和互助的精神讓每個成員都能夠和諧共處，互相支持，共同克服困難。
sentences.en: In this community, the spirit of harmony and mutual help enables every member to coexist peacefully, support one another, and collectively overcome challenges.

phrase.en: A Harmonious Family Calls for Celebration

sentences.zh: 在這個喜慶的時刻，我們慶祝人和家慶，珍惜家人之間的和諧與幸福。
sentences.en: In this festive moment, we celebrate a harmonious family, cherishing the peace and happiness among family members.

phrase.zh: 人和家慶 金玉滿堂
phrase.en: A Harmonious Family Calls for Celebration; A House Filled with Treasures of Gold and Jade

sentences.zh: 在這個佳節之際，家人們相聚一起，真是人和家慶金玉滿堂，象徵著家庭的和諧與繁榮。
sentences.en: During this festive season, as the family gathers together, it truly embodies a harmonious family calling for celebration; a house filled with treasures of gold and jade, symbolizing harmony and prosperity.

phrase.zh: 人在眾中 心在定中
phrase.en: Settle Amongst People, Abide in Meditative Concentration

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的會議中，他依然能保持冷靜，真正做到了人在眾中，心在定中。
sentences.en: Even amidst the busy meeting, he was able to maintain his composure, truly embodying the ability to settle amongst people while abiding in meditative concentration.

phrase.zh: 人在眾中 心在定裏
phrase.en: Settle Amongst People, Abide in Meditative Concentration

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的生活中，他能做到人在眾中心在定裏，即使周圍喧囂，他依然能保持內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: In the midst of a busy life, he is able to settle amongst people and abide in meditative concentration, maintaining inner peace even amid the surrounding noise.

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，人天的關係強調了人類與天界神祇之間的互動，這是通往解脫的重要一環。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the relationship between humans and devas emphasizes the interactions between humanity and celestial beings, which is an essential aspect of the path to liberation.

phrase.en: Joy for Both Heavenly and Human Beings

sentences.zh: 當慈悲的行為在社會中傳播時，大家都能感受到人天歡喜的氛圍，無論是人類還是天界的生靈都會因此而愉悅。
sentences.en: When acts of compassion spread throughout society, everyone can feel the atmosphere of joy for both heavenly and human beings, and both humans and celestial beings will rejoice as a result.

sentences.zh: 修行者需要開啟人天眼目，以便洞察宇宙的奧秘，理解生命的真相。
sentences.en: The practitioner needs to awaken the eyes of heaven and earth to discern the mysteries of the universe and understand the truth of life.

phrase.en: The importance of learning how to be a human

sentences.zh: 在當今的社會中，人學的重要性日益凸顯，因為理解人性與他人互動的方式能促進更和諧的社會關係。
sentences.en: In today's society, the importance of learning how to be a human is increasingly highlighted, as understanding human nature and ways to interact with others can promote more harmonious social relationships.

sentences.zh: 他被尊稱為人師，不僅因為他教導知識，更因為他以身作則，培養出無數優秀的人才。
sentences.en: He is revered as a teacher of humans, not only for imparting knowledge but also for leading by example and nurturing countless outstanding individuals.

phrase.en: Buddhahood Is Attained Upon the Attainment of a Perfected Character

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，人成佛成的概念強調了修行和自身品格的提升是通往證悟之路的重要因素。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the concept that Buddhahood is attained upon the attainment of a perfected character emphasizes that personal cultivation and character development are crucial factors on the path to enlightenment.

phrase.en: Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人成即佛成的教義告訴我們，只要我們精進修行、淨化自身的品格，便能在瞬間達到佛果。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the doctrine of 'Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected' teaches us that through diligent practice and the purification of our character, we can achieve enlightenment in an instant.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法使我體悟到人我不二的關係，了解到每個生命都是相互聯結的，無法分割。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism has helped me realize the unity of self and others, understanding that every life is interconnected and inseparable.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和反思，我們學會了人我互換，這使我們更好地理解他人的感受和經歷。
sentences.en: Through meditation and reflection, we learn to switch places with others, which allows us to better understand their feelings and experiences.

phrase.en: Auspicious Blessings for the Self and Others

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，人我吉祥的理念提醒我們，當我們為自己和他人祈求吉祥的祝福時，心中應該充滿善念。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, the concept of auspicious blessings for the self and others reminds us that when we pray for blessings for ourselves and others, our hearts should be filled with goodwill.

sentences.zh: 在這個社區中，我們倡導人我和敬的價值觀，鼓勵每一個成員互相尊重並和諧共處。
sentences.en: In this community, we promote the values of harmonious and respectful relations, encouraging every member to respect one another and live together harmoniously.

phrase.zh: 人我和敬 共生吉祥
phrase.en: Harmonious and Respectful Relations; Auspicious Coexistence

sentences.zh: 在這個多元文化的社會中，我們應該追求「人我和敬，共生吉祥」的理念，以建立和諧與尊重的關係。
sentences.en: In this multicultural society, we should strive for the principle of 'harmonious and respectful relations; auspicious coexistence' to establish harmony and respect among one another.

sentences.zh: 只有實踐「人我和敬，共生吉祥」，我們才能真正體驗到彼此之間的共融與幸福。
sentences.en: Only by practicing 'harmonious and respectful relations; auspicious coexistence', can we truly experience the integration and happiness between one another.

phrase.en: characteristics of the self and others

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，理解人我相有助於我們認識自我的本質以及他人的特性，從而達到更深層次的人際關係。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, understanding the characteristics of the self and others helps us recognize the nature of ourselves and the traits of others, leading to deeper interpersonal relationships.

sentences.zh: 人文國小以其重視道德教育和人文精神而聞名，培養出許多有責任感的學生。
sentences.en: Ilan Humanity Primary School is renowned for its emphasis on moral education and humanistic spirit, nurturing many responsible students.

phrase.en: An Upright Personality Makes a Good Heart

sentences.zh: 他待人誠懇，因為他相信人正心好，這樣才能建立真摯的友誼。
sentences.en: He treats others sincerely because he believes that an upright personality makes a good heart, which is essential for building genuine friendships.

sentences.zh: 在這個社會中，人正心好的人總是能獲得他人的尊重與信任。
sentences.en: In this society, those with an upright personality and a good heart always earn the respect and trust of others.

phrase.en: An Upright Character with a Mind at Peace

sentences.zh: 在這個浮躁的社會中，他始終以人正心安的態度面對生活的挑戰，讓他如沐春風，心境平和。
sentences.en: In this restless society, he always faces the challenges of life with an upright character and a mind at peace, allowing him to feel refreshed and maintain a serene state of mind.

phrase.zh: 人死亡之後的生命怎麼樣
phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: When We Die

sentences.zh: 根據佛教的教義，人死亡之後的生命並不是結束，而是生命輪迴的一部分，這提醒我們在每一個當下都要珍惜當前的存在。
sentences.en: According to Buddhist teachings, life after death is not an end but a part of the cycle of existence, reminding us to cherish our current life in every moment.

phrase.zh: 人海慈航─怎樣知道有觀世音菩薩
phrase.en: A Compassionate Ferry: Where is Guanyin Bodhisattva?

sentences.zh: 在生活的波濤洶湧中，許多人都在尋找那條能引導他們的慈航，而問自己：人海之中，怎樣知道有觀世音菩薩的存在呢？
sentences.en: Amidst the turbulent waves of life, many are searching for the compassionate ferry that can guide them, asking themselves: in the vast sea of humanity, how can one know the presence of Guanyin Bodhisattva?

phrase.en: Lamp in the Ocean of People

sentences.zh: 在這個熙熙攘攘的城市中，她願意成為人海燈，照亮那些需要幫助的人的心靈。
sentences.en: In this bustling city, she wishes to be a lamp in the ocean of people, illuminating the hearts of those in need.

phrase.zh: 人無信不立 天有日方明
phrase.en: Dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on; Only in the presence of the sun can the sky light up.

sentences.zh: 在這個社會中，人無信不立，任何不誠實的行為都會使自己失去立足之地，就像只有在陽光明媚的日子裡，天空才能真正散發光彩。
sentences.en: In this society, dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on; any dishonest behavior will cause you to lose your footing, just as the sky can only truly shine on sunny days.

phrase.en: Live three hundred years' worth of life.

sentences.zh: 他常常說，人生三百歲不僅是要活得長久，更是要活得精彩，充實每一天。
sentences.en: He often says that to live three hundred years' worth of life is not just about longevity, but also about living vibrantly and making each day fulfilling.

phrase.zh: 人生三百歲，寺院億萬千
phrase.en: Live a life worth three hundred years' endeavors; Building temples in thousands and millions.

sentences.zh: 在修行過程中，我們應該珍惜每一刻，如同人生三百歲，讓每一天都充滿意義，並努力建設寺院億萬千來弘揚佛法。
sentences.en: In the process of cultivation, we should cherish every moment, as if living a life worth three hundred years, making each day meaningful, and striving to build temples in thousands and millions to propagate the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在爭執時，友善地一笑不僅能平息緊張的氣氛，還展現了人生的風度。
sentences.en: A friendly smile in times of quarrel not only eases the tense atmosphere but also demonstrates one's demeanor.

sentences.zh: 當面對吃虧的情況時，微微一笑顯示出我們的大度與包容，讓周圍的人感受到寬容的力量。
sentences.en: A faint smile in times of disadvantage shows our generosity and tolerance, allowing those around us to feel the power of forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 在遭遇委屈時，坦然一笑讓我們表現出自信，並在困難中保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: A genuine smile in times of aggrievement allows us to express our confidence while maintaining inner peace amid difficulties.

sentences.zh: 當感到無奈時，我們用幽默的一笑來釋放壓力，這展現了我們對人生的自在態度。
sentences.en: A subtle smile in times of helplessness releases pressure, demonstrating our ease with life's unpredictability.

sentences.zh: 在危險來臨時，泰然一笑讓我們表現出定力，堅定地面對一切挑戰。
sentences.en: A composed smile in times of danger showcases our calmness, allowing us to face any challenges with determination.

sentences.zh: 當我們生氣時，平靜的一笑彰顯了我們的修養，幫助我們冷靜思考。
sentences.en: A peaceful smile in times of anger reflects our disposition, aiding us to think clearly and calmly.

sentences.zh: 遭遇尷尬時，會心的一笑不僅讓自己放鬆，也教會別人以智慧看待小失誤。
sentences.en: A reassuring smile in times of embarrassment not only relaxes us but also teaches others to view small mistakes with wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在面對挫折時，淡然一笑讓我們不至於沉淪，展現出堅強的內心力量。
sentences.en: A bland smile in times of setback prevents us from sinking into despair, demonstrating our inner strength.

sentences.zh: 失意時，樂觀的一笑讓我們展現出人生的豁達，帶給自己和他人新的希望。
sentences.en: A cheerful smile in times of disappointment reveals our magnanimity, bringing renewed hope to ourselves and others.

sentences.zh: 當面對恐懼時，輕鬆的一笑能讓我們勇敢地迎接挑戰，克服內心的不安。
sentences.en: An airy smile in times of fear allows us to courageously face challenges, overcoming our inner unease.

sentences.zh: 在誤會時，她灑脫一笑，展現出她人生的修為，讓彼此的緊張氣氛瞬間化解。
sentences.en: In times of misunderstanding, she wore a carefree smile, demonstrating her deportment and instantly dissolving the tension between them.

sentences.zh: 分手時，他優雅一笑，讓對方感受到他對過去的尊重，展現了他人生的大氣。
sentences.en: During the breakup, he smiled elegantly, showing respect for their past together, a demonstration of his manner.

sentences.zh: 在生疏的場合中，他親切一笑，讓周圍的人都感受到他的隨和，打破了陌生感。
sentences.en: In a situation of estrangement, he smiled amiably, making those around him feel his friendliness and breaking the sense of unfamiliarity.

sentences.zh: 面對困難的狀況時，她轉念一笑，展現出她的睿智，讓大家都相信一切會好起來。
sentences.en: In the face of difficult circumstances, she turned her thoughts and smiled, demonstrating her cleverness and reassuring everyone that things would get better.

sentences.zh: 羞愧之際，他大方一笑，讓人感受到他的率真，並展示了他對自己的接納。
sentences.en: In a moment of shame, he smiled graciously, allowing others to feel his ingenuousness and showcasing his acceptance of himself.

sentences.zh: 生病期間，她仍然達觀一笑，展現出她的正面態度，鼓勵身邊的人一起堅強。
sentences.en: Even while ill, she remained optimistic with a smile, demonstrating her positive attitude and encouraging those around her to stay strong.

sentences.zh: 苦惱之時，他開懷一笑，展現出他的人生氣度，讓朋友們都感受到了一絲安慰。
sentences.en: In moments of distress, he smiled happily, demonstrating his composure in life and providing a sense of comfort to his friends.

sentences.zh: 緊張的會議上，她天真一笑，展現了她的直率，讓大家放鬆了心情。
sentences.en: In the tense meeting, she smiled honestly, demonstrating her frankness and helping everyone relax.

sentences.zh: 被朋友騙了之後，他開朗一笑，展現了他對人生的坦蕩，讓人們都佩服他的心胸。
sentences.en: After being deceived by a friend, he smiled brightly, demonstrating his open-mindedness about life and earning admiration from those around him.

sentences.zh: 在成功的時候，她含蓄一笑，展現出她的人生謙卑，讓人們更加尊敬她的成就。
sentences.en: In times of triumph, she smiled reservedly, demonstrating her humility in life and earning greater respect for her achievements.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns

sentences.zh: 在我們的修行過程中，思考人生十問能幫助我們更深入地理解自己的內心與周遭的世界。
sentences.en: In our journey of practice, contemplating the ten common concerns of life helps us gain a deeper understanding of our inner self and the surrounding world.

sentences.zh: 在這個充滿挑戰的世界中，我們必須學會相信人生卜事的智慧，保持積極的心態迎接未來。
sentences.en: In this challenging world, we must learn to trust the wisdom of positive forecasts for life and maintain an optimistic attitude towards the future.

phrase.zh: 人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家
phrase.en: Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home.

sentences.zh: 在這無常的世界中，我常常思考 '人生如夢誰是我'，這讓我對自我的認識變得更加深刻，而當我意識到到處能安即是家時，我的心靈也獲得了真正的平靜。
sentences.en: In this impermanent world, I often ponder 'Life is but a dream, so who am I?', which deepens my understanding of the self; and when I realize that peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home, my spirit finds true tranquility.

sentences.zh: 人生如畫，每一個階段都像是一幅別具風格的畫作，充滿了色彩和故事。
sentences.en: Life is like a painting, where each stage resembles a uniquely styled artwork, full of colors and stories.

sentences.zh: 在《人生月刊》中，讀者可以找到關於人生哲學、心靈成長和佛教教義的深入探討。
sentences.en: In the Human Life Monthly Magazine, readers can find in-depth explorations of life philosophy, personal growth, and Buddhist teachings.

phrase.zh: 人生無量壽 佛教億萬年
phrase.en: Life is ageless; Faith is timeless.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人生無量壽的觀念提醒我們生命的真正本質是超越時間的，因此我們的信仰也該是永恆不變的，無論面對多少挑戰與變遷。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the notion that life is ageless reminds us that the true essence of existence transcends time, and thus our faith should be eternal and unchanging, regardless of the challenges and changes we face.

phrase.zh: 人生猶似西山日 富貴終如草上霜
phrase.en: Life is like the setting sun in the West; Wealth is nothing but dew on grass.

sentences.zh: 人生猶似西山日，無論我們擁有多少富貴，終將如草上霜般逝去，因此應該珍惜當下的每一分每一秒。
sentences.en: Life is like the setting sun in the West; no matter how much wealth we possess, it will eventually fade away like dew on grass, so we should cherish every moment we have.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，我們總是面臨著人生百事，而每一項任務都讓我們變得更加成熟與智慧。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, we are always faced with one hundred tasks of life, and each task helps us grow in maturity and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 人生需具希望，才能在困難中持續前行，就如同在黑暗中尋找一線光明。
sentences.en: We must have hope in order to live, just as one seeks a ray of light in the darkness during difficult times.

sentences.zh: 展望明天，是人生存在的基石，讓我們有勇氣面對未知的未來。
sentences.en: Having a tomorrow is the cornerstone of existence, giving us the courage to face the unknown future.

sentences.zh: 信仰是人生意義的源泉，它幫助我們在挑戰中找到方向與力量。
sentences.en: Faith is the source of meaning in life, helping us to find direction and strength in the face of challenges.

sentences.zh: 每天都有工作，是賦予生活意義的重要部分，讓我們能夠實現自我價值。
sentences.en: Having a job to do every day is an important part of giving life meaning, allowing us to realize our self-worth.

sentences.zh: 人生的眼界需要遠見，有助於我們做出明智的決策與選擇。
sentences.en: Perspective in our vision requires foresight, aiding us in making wise decisions and choices.

sentences.zh: 為未來制訂計劃，使我們的人生更具方向感，不至於迷失。
sentences.en: Creating a plan for the future gives our lives direction, preventing us from feeling lost.

sentences.zh: 在做事的過程中，我們必須具備觀察力，這樣才能及時調整自己的策略。
sentences.en: We must be observant when completing tasks, allowing us to adjust our strategies in a timely manner.

sentences.zh: 人生中結緣有助於建立相互扶持的關係，讓我們在困難時擁有助力。
sentences.en: Developing affinities in life helps establish supportive relationships, giving us assistance during tough times.

sentences.zh: 朋友間的情義是人生的重要財富，讓我們在相互扶持中成長。
sentences.en: The sentiment and loyalty shared among friends is a vital treasure in life, allowing us to grow through mutual support.

sentences.zh: 仁慈的性格使我們在對待他人時更加寬容，從而促進和諧的人際關係。
sentences.en: Having a compassionate character allows us to be more tolerant in our interactions with others, fostering harmonious relationships.

sentences.zh: 在追求進步的過程中，我們需要尋找動力來推動自我成長與發展。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of progress, we need motivation to drive our personal growth and development.

sentences.zh: 對社會的服務不僅是對他人的回饋，也是我們找到人生位置的途徑。
sentences.en: Offering our service to society is not only a way to give back to others, but also a path to finding our place in life.

sentences.zh: 我們在做事時必須周全考慮，以避免造成不必要的困擾與麻煩。
sentences.en: We must be considerate in everything we do to avoid causing unnecessary troubles and inconveniences.

sentences.zh: 為了生存，我們需要建立良好的結緣，從而能在必要時獲得支持。
sentences.en: To survive, we need to cultivate good affinities so that we can receive support when needed.

sentences.zh: 活動的空間對於人生的活力至關重要，讓我們能夠自由地追求夢想。
sentences.en: Space for activity is crucial for the vibrancy of life, allowing us to freely pursue our dreams.

sentences.zh: 人生中積善需要無私的行為，以便在未來收穫更多的福報。
sentences.en: Accumulating good in life requires selfless actions, enabling us to reap greater blessings in the future.

sentences.zh: 在評斷事情時，我們必須具備明鑒的能力，以做出合理的選擇。
sentences.en: We must possess clarity in judgment to make rational choices when evaluating situations.

sentences.zh: 人生的滋長需要忙碌，因為只有在付出中，我們才能看到自己的成就與成長。
sentences.en: Life flourishes through industriousness, as it is only in our efforts that we can witness our achievements and growth.

sentences.zh: 我們必須對人生的安危仔細思量，這樣能幫助我們預防未來的問題。
sentences.en: We must thoughtfully consider the safety and risks of life to help us prevent future problems.

sentences.zh: 在生活中，智慧的選擇能幫助我們正確評估可否之事，達成心中的目標。
sentences.en: Wise choices in life help us accurately assess what is possible and what is not, enabling us to achieve our desired goals.

sentences.zh: 人生諸苦提醒我們，每個人都面臨不同的挑戰和困難，無論是從慳貪、揮霍、懶惰還是其他行為中所引發的痛苦。
sentences.en: The pains of life remind us that everyone faces different challenges and hardships, whether from stinginess, extravagance, laziness, or other behaviors that lead to suffering.

sentences.zh: 慳貪之人伶仃孤苦，因為他們害怕分享而孤立自己，最終只剩下寂寞的心靈。
sentences.en: Stingy and greedy people suffer the pain of loneliness because they isolate themselves for fear of sharing, leaving only a lonely spirit in the end.

sentences.zh: 揮霍之人求不得苦，儘管他們擁有物質卻總是無法滿足，內心空虛。
sentences.en: Extravagant people experience the pain of discontent, as they possess material wealth yet can never find satisfaction, leaving them feeling empty inside.

sentences.zh: 懶惰之人千辛萬苦，因為他們的懶惰使得生活中的基本需求都變得困難重重。
sentences.en: Lazy people endure great hardship, as their laziness makes even basic necessities of life challenging.

sentences.zh: 矯情之人嘴甜心苦，外表的優雅掩蓋了內心的惶恐和不安。
sentences.en: Pretentious individuals may have sweet words, but their hearts are filled with pain and turmoil, as the elegance they project conceals inner unease.

sentences.zh: 麻木之人不知甘苦，對生活中的酸甜苦辣感到漠不關心，最終失去了感受的能力。
sentences.en: Nonchalant people remain unaware of the bittersweetness of life, feeling indifferent to its ups and downs, ultimately losing the ability to feel.

sentences.zh: 執著之人放不下苦，他們常常因無法放手而經歷心靈的煎熬。
sentences.en: Stubborn individuals suffer the pain of attachment, often enduring mental torment because they cannot let go.

sentences.zh: 瞋恨之人怨憎會苦，憤怒與怨恨讓他們無法獲得內心的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Angry individuals experience the pain of unpleasant meetings, as their anger and resentment prevent them from finding inner peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 五逆之人倒懸悲苦，這些不道德的行為使得他們的人生陷入更深的痛苦之中。
sentences.en: Those who commit the Five Offenses bear the pain of being born as animals, as their immoral actions plunge them deeper into suffering.

sentences.zh: 風塵之人內心痛苦，流浪的生活使他們失去了歸屬感和安全感。
sentences.en: Vagrants suffer the pain of displacement, as their nomadic lives strip them of a sense of belonging and security.

sentences.zh: 邊疆之人窮困辛苦，在艱難的環境中他們每日都在為生存而奮鬥。
sentences.en: People living in outlying areas endure the pain of destitution, as they struggle daily for survival in harsh conditions.

sentences.zh: 軍中之人戰鬥累苦，為了保衛國家，他們承受著無數的艱辛與勞累。
sentences.en: Soldiers suffer the pain of battle, enduring countless hardships and fatigue in their quest to defend the nation.

sentences.zh: 病亡之人愛別離苦，疾病和死亡讓他們與摯愛的親人永別。
sentences.en: Those who face sickness and death endure the pain of separation from loved ones, as illness and mortality force them to part ways.

sentences.zh: 乞討之人淒涼哀苦，失去生活的自信和能力，他們的生活充滿了絕望。
sentences.en: Beggar lives are filled with desolation and sorrow, having lost confidence and the ability to sustain life, leaving them in a state of despair.

sentences.zh: 創業之人備嘗辛苦，面對無數的挑戰，這一切都是為了實現夢想而不懈奮鬥。
sentences.en: Entrepreneurs endure toil and fatigue, facing countless challenges in their relentless struggle to achieve their dreams.

sentences.zh: 發心之人不辭勞苦，懷著仁愛之心，他們在追求自己的目標時不怕吃苦。
sentences.en: Those with aspirations do not shy away from labor, as they pursue their goals with a heart full of compassion, unafraid of hardships.

sentences.zh: 養育之人含辛茹苦，為了給孩子一個美好的未來，他們甘願承擔所有的艱辛。
sentences.en: Parents willingly endure the hardships of raising a child, as they strive to provide their children with a bright future.

sentences.zh: 情義之人同甘共苦，無論順境還是逆境，他們都在彼此面前分享生活的酸甜苦辣。
sentences.en: Righteous and loyal individuals share both joys and pains, experiencing together the sweet and bitter aspects of life in both good and bad times.

sentences.zh: 勤奮之人不以為苦，因為他們知道，努力才是收穫的關鍵。
sentences.en: Diligent individuals do not consider their hard work as suffering, as they understand that effort is the key to reaping rewards.

sentences.zh: 慈悲之人喜樂拔苦，他們的善行能夠為他人帶來快樂，解除他們的痛苦。
sentences.en: Compassionate people bring joy and alleviate the suffering of others through their good deeds.

sentences.zh: 喜捨之人濟貧救苦，用他們的慷慨行為幫助那些困苦中的人們。
sentences.en: Generous individuals help those in pain through acts of giving, offering support to those in need.

sentences.zh: 積善之人無有眾苦，因為他們用善行的積累，讓自己的生活變得更加美好。
sentences.en: Those who accumulate good deeds are free from all forms of pain, as their virtuous actions enrich their lives.

phrase.en: It is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma

sentences.zh: 在這個世界上，人生難得，大道難聞，能夠遇到真正的佛法是一種稀有的機會，我們應當珍惜。
sentences.en: In this world, it is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma; encountering the true teachings of Buddhism is a rare opportunity that we should cherish.

phrase.en: It is important to feel pain and affliction

sentences.zh: 在生命的旅程中，人要知道苦惱，因為這些痛苦的經歷使我們更加珍惜快樂的時刻。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, it is important to feel pain and affliction, as these painful experiences make us cherish the moments of joy even more.

phrase.zh: 人貴無求 心安有福
phrase.en: It is Best to Be Desireless; A Peaceful Mind is Naturally Happy

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的生活中，我逐漸體會到人貴無求，心安有福，只有放下內心的渴望，才能找到真正的平靜與快樂。
sentences.en: In the busyness of life, I gradually realized that it is best to be desireless; a peaceful mind is naturally happy. Only by letting go of inner desires can one find true serenity and joy.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，人貴相知，因此我珍惜與你之間的友誼。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, friendship is precious, which is why I cherish the bond we share.

phrase.en: A Friend Who Knows You is Most Valuable

sentences.zh: 在生活的旅程中，擁有一位人貴知心的朋友無疑是最大的財富，他能理解你的感受並支持你。
sentences.en: On the journey of life, having a friend who knows you is undoubtedly the greatest wealth, as they can understand your feelings and support you.

phrase.zh: 人貴自知 自知者明
phrase.en: Nobility Comes from Within; It Takes One to Know One

sentences.zh: 真正的高貴在於對自己的認識，正如古語所說：人貴自知，自知者明。
sentences.en: True nobility lies in self-awareness, as the ancient saying goes: 'Nobility comes from within; it takes one to know one.'

sentences.zh: 在這個瞬息萬變的社會中，唯有深刻的自知才能讓一個人撇開外在的評價，保持內心的平靜與清明。
sentences.en: In this ever-changing society, only profound self-awareness allows a person to set aside external judgments and maintain inner peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 在這個人間，我們需要珍惜每一個生命，並在平和共處的基礎上建立和諧的社會。
sentences.en: In this human world, we need to cherish every life and build a harmonious society based on peaceful coexistence.

sentences.zh: 在這個人間，能夠享受到生活中的一切美好就好，而不必執著於擁有更多的物品。
sentences.en: In this world, it is enough to enjoy the beauty of life without being attached to possessing more things.

sentences.zh: 穿著得體且舒適就好，不必追求名牌的包裝。
sentences.en: It is enough to dress appropriately and comfortably, without having to chase after brand names.

sentences.zh: 只要能夠三餐溫飽，就好，不必苛求每一餐都是美食。
sentences.en: It is enough to have enough food for three meals a day, without demanding that every meal be gourmet.

sentences.zh: 生活中居家舒適就好，不必過於華麗會讓人感到壓力。
sentences.en: It is enough to have a comfortable home, without the need for extravagance that can cause stress.

sentences.zh: 擁有一個安靜的睡眠空間就好，並不需要特別寬廣。
sentences.en: It is enough to have a peaceful sleeping space, without requiring it to be overly spacious.

sentences.zh: 旅行時只要平安就好，不必逞強於其他人的旅程。
sentences.en: When traveling, it is enough to be safe, without needing to outdo others in adventures.

sentences.zh: 親友的安全就好，不必因為一些小事情而牽掛。
sentences.en: It is enough that family and friends are safe, without worrying over minor issues.

sentences.zh: 知足常樂的生活就好，不必刻意追求奢華。
sentences.en: A life of contentment is enough, without the need to deliberately seek luxury.

sentences.zh: 面對過去的事情，只需放下就好，無需懷念。
sentences.en: When facing the past, it is enough to let go, with no need for nostalgia.

sentences.zh: 與朋友的交情保持淡而不濃就好，友誼也能自在隨和。
sentences.en: It is enough to maintain a light friendship with friends, allowing for ease and comfort.

sentences.zh: 夫妻之間的信任就好，無需互相多疑。
sentences.en: It is enough for spouses to trust each other, without harboring unnecessary suspicion.

sentences.zh: 對於承諾，只需履行就好，不必計較是否得到稱讚。
sentences.en: For commitments, it is enough to fulfill them without calculating whether praise is received.

sentences.zh: 內心的單純就好，無需過多的煩惱與困擾。
sentences.en: It is enough to have a pure heart, without the burdens of excessive worries and troubles.

sentences.zh: 舉止莊重就好，而非追求矯情的表現。
sentences.en: It is enough to have dignified behavior, rather than seeking pretentious displays.

sentences.zh: 能夠依賴自己就好，無需過於依靠他人。
sentences.en: It is enough to rely on oneself without excessively depending on others.

sentences.zh: 善惡分明的標準就好，不必過於計較身邊的事。
sentences.en: It is enough to have clear distinctions between right and wrong, without being overly calculative about things around.

sentences.zh: 能夠隨和的融入環境就好，而不是拘泥於形式。
sentences.en: It is enough to blend in with the environment easily, rather than being stuck on formalities.

sentences.zh: 隨著緣分的到來而活就好，不必對事物過分執著。
sentences.en: It is enough to live according to the flow of fate, without being overly attached to things.

sentences.zh: 只要金錢夠用就好，不必貪求更多。
sentences.en: It is enough to have enough money, without the need to chase after more.

sentences.zh: 活得快樂就好，無需因小事而心生煩憂。
sentences.en: It is enough to live joyfully, without letting small matters bring trouble.

phrase.en: Buddha Land in the Human World - The Making of the Buddha Memorial Center

sentences.zh: 在這個信仰的中心，我們希望能夠創造一個人間佛國，讓每個人都能在此找到內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: In this center of faith, we aspire to create a Buddha Land in the Human World, where everyone can find inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教強調將佛教的教義應用於日常生活中，以促進人類的幸福與和平。
sentences.en: Humanistic Buddhism emphasizes the application of Buddhist teachings in everyday life to promote human happiness and peace.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，我們常常在疑惑中思索人間佛教何處尋，試圖找到那條通往內心平靜與智慧的道路。
sentences.en: In our daily lives, we often ponder where to find the way of humanistic Buddhism, seeking that path to inner peace and wisdom.

phrase.en: Humanistic Buddhism: Holding True to the Original Intents of Buddha

sentences.zh: 人間佛教佛陀本懷強調佛教教義應該應用於日常生活中，以利於社會的和諧與人心的淨化。
sentences.en: Humanistic Buddhism: Holding True to the Original Intents of Buddha emphasizes that Buddhist teachings should be applied to daily life to benefit social harmony and purify the hearts of people.

sentences.zh: 今年的行善活動中，我們將舉辦一場人間佛教唱歌比賽，讓參賽者透過音樂傳遞慈悲與和平的理念。
sentences.en: This year, as part of our charitable activities, we will hold a Humanistic Buddhism Singing Contest, allowing participants to convey the ideals of compassion and peace through music.

sentences.zh: 每年，人間佛教國際電影展都吸引了來自世界各地的電影愛好者，展示關於佛教及人性的感人故事。
sentences.en: Every year, the Humanistic Buddhism International Film Festival attracts movie enthusiasts from around the world, showcasing poignant stories about Buddhism and humanity.

phrase.en: Humanistic Buddhism: Journal, Arts and Culture
